points.title: 早年生活
points.description: 穆夏出生于摩拉维亚地区的伊万尼采，在一个虔诚的家庭中长大。他的父亲是法庭书记员，母亲是家庭主妇。尽管家庭经济拮据，但父母仍支持他的艺术天赋。穆夏从小就展现出绘画才能，在教堂和当地民间艺术中汲取灵感。这段经历对他后来的装饰艺术风格产生了深远影响，尤其是对斯拉夫民族元素的运用。
points.descriptionEn: Mucha was born in Ivančice in Moravia, into a devout family. His father was a court clerk and his mother a housekeeper. Despite financial constraints, his parents supported his artistic talent. Mucha showed artistic talent from a young age, drawing inspiration from church art and local folk art. This period profoundly influenced his later decorative art style, particularly his use of Slavic national elements.

points.title: 艺术求学
points.description: 穆夏前往维也纳，在剧院场景设计工作室工作，同时继续自学绘画。在这里，他接触到了欧洲最新的艺术潮流，并参与了多个舞台设计项目。1885年，一位伯爵资助他前往慕尼黑艺术学院学习。在维也纳和慕尼黑期间，穆夏发展了对戏剧艺术和装饰设计的浓厚兴趣，这为他后来的海报设计奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: Mucha moved to Vienna, working in a theater set design studio while continuing to teach himself painting. Here, he was exposed to the latest European art trends and participated in various stage design projects. In 1885, a count sponsored him to study at the Munich Academy of Fine Arts. During his time in Vienna and Munich, Mucha developed a keen interest in theatrical art and decorative design, laying the foundation for his later poster work.

points.title: 突破与成名
points.description: 穆夏移居巴黎，在朱利安学院和科拉罗西学院学习。1894年，他偶然获得为莎拉·伯恩哈特主演的新戏剧《吉斯蒙达》设计海报的机会。这幅海报立即引起轰动，其优雅的新艺术风格迅速风靡巴黎。此后，穆夏成为巴黎最受欢迎的艺术家之一，为许多商业项目、杂志和广告创作了大量作品。这一时期他发展出标志性的风格：流畅的线条、花卉装饰和理想化的女性形象。
points.descriptionEn: Mucha moved to Paris, studying at the Académie Julian and Académie Colarossi. In 1894, he was given the chance to design a poster for Sarah Bernhardt's new play 'Gismonda' by chance. The poster caused an immediate sensation, and its elegant Art Nouveau style quickly became popular in Paris. Thereafter, Mucha became one of Paris's most sought-after artists, creating numerous works for commercial projects, magazines, and advertisements. During this period, he developed his signature style: flowing lines, floral decorations, and idealized female figures.

points.title: 艺术巅峰
points.description: 在巴黎的巅峰时期，穆夏创作了著名的《四季》、《一天》和《星辰》等系列作品，这些作品展现了他对自然循环和女性美的独特诠释。他还设计了大量商业海报、珠宝、包装和室内装饰。1900年巴黎世博会上，穆夏的斯拉夫民族装饰艺术展厅获得巨大成功，使他成为新艺术运动的代表人物。这一时期，他开始关注斯拉夫民族艺术，创作了《斯拉夫史诗》的初步构思。
points.descriptionEn: During his peak in Paris, Mucha created famous series such as 'The Seasons,' 'The Times of Day,' and 'The Stars,' showcasing his unique interpretation of natural cycles and feminine beauty. He also designed numerous commercial posters, jewelry, packaging, and interior decorations. At the 1900 Paris Exposition Universelle, Mucha's Slavic decorative art pavilion was a great success, establishing him as a leading figure of the Art Nouveau movement. During this period, he began focusing on Slavic national art, developing the initial concept for 'The Slav Epic'.

points.title: 回归祖国
points.description: 受捷克民族复兴运动的影响，穆夏回到布拉格，致力于将艺术与民族认同相结合。他设计了布拉格市民剧院的装饰，创作了纪念捷克民族复兴的壁画。1912年，他开始构思大型系列作品《斯拉夫史诗》，旨在展现斯拉夫民族的历史和精神。一战期间，穆夏积极参与捷克独立运动，设计了许多爱国宣传品。这一时期，他的艺术风格更加注重民族元素和历史叙事。
points.descriptionEn: Influenced by the Czech National Revival movement, Mucha returned to Prague, dedicating himself to combining art with national identity. He designed decorations for the Prague Municipal Theater and created murals commemorating the Czech National Revival. In 1912, he began conceiving the large-scale series 'The Slav Epic,' aiming to portray the history and spirit of the Slavic peoples. During World War I, Mucha actively participated in the Czech independence movement, designing many patriotic propaganda materials. During this period, his artistic style placed greater emphasis on national elements and historical narratives.

points.title: 晚年创作
points.description: 穆夏晚年专注于完成《斯拉夫史诗》这一宏大的艺术项目，共创作20幅巨幅画作，描绘斯拉夫民族从史前到20世纪初的历史。这些作品耗费了他大量精力，并在1928年全部完成后捐赠给布拉格。除了《斯拉夫史诗》，他还创作了许多肖像画、风景画和设计作品。1939年，德国入侵捷克斯洛伐克后，穆夏因年迈被捕，不久后在布拉格逝世，享年79岁。他的去世标志着一个艺术时代的终结。
points.descriptionEn: In his later years, Mucha focused on completing 'The Slav Epic,' his monumental artistic project consisting of 20 large paintings depicting the history of the Slavic peoples from prehistoric times to the early 20th century. These works consumed much of his energy, and upon their completion in 1928, he donated them all to Prague. In addition to 'The Slav Epic,' he created many portraits, landscapes, and design works. In 1939, after Germany invaded Czechoslovakia, Mucha was arrested due to his age and died shortly thereafter in Prague at the age of 79. His death marked the end of an artistic era.

supporter.zh: 穆夏是新艺术运动的先驱和代表人物，他的作品融合了东方美学与西方传统，创造了独特的装饰艺术风格。他的女性形象优雅而富有生命力，线条流畅，色彩和谐，影响了整个欧洲的视觉艺术。穆夏不仅是艺术家，还是民族主义者，他将艺术与民族认同紧密结合，通过《斯拉夫史诗》等作品表达了对斯拉夫民族文化的热爱和自豪。他的作品至今仍被视为装饰艺术的典范，对现代设计和插画艺术有着深远影响。
supporter.en: Mucha was a pioneer and leading figure of the Art Nouveau movement, whose works fused Eastern aesthetics with Western traditions to create a unique decorative art style. His female figures are elegant and full of vitality, with flowing lines and harmonious colors that influenced European visual arts. Mucha was not just an artist but also a nationalist who closely linked art with national identity, expressing his love and pride for Slavic culture through works like 'The Slav Epic'. His works remain considered masterpieces of decorative art, having a profound influence on modern design and illustration.

critic.zh: 批评者认为穆夏的作品过于商业化，尤其是他在巴黎时期的大量商业海报和广告设计，削弱了他作为艺术家的纯粹性。他的风格被指责为肤浅和甜腻，缺乏深度和思想性。此外，穆夏的民族主义立场也受到质疑，他的《斯拉夫史诗》被批评为过于理想化和民族主义，缺乏对历史复杂性的客观呈现。一些艺术评论家认为，穆夏后期作品缺乏创新，重复使用相同的构图和元素，显示出艺术创作的衰退。
critic.en: Critics argue that Mucha's work was overly commercial, particularly his numerous commercial posters and advertisements during his Paris period, which diminished his purity as an artist. His style has been criticized as superficial and saccharine, lacking depth and intellectual substance. Additionally, Mucha's nationalist stance has been questioned, with 'The Slav Epic' criticized for being overly idealistic and nationalist, failing to present historical complexity objectively. Some art critics believe his later works lacked innovation, repeating the same compositions and elements, showing a decline in artistic creativity.

objective.zh: 从历史和流行文化视角看，穆夏是连接19世纪末装饰艺术与20世纪现代设计的重要桥梁。他的作品不仅影响了当时的视觉艺术，还对后来的装饰艺术、平面设计和插画产生了深远影响。在流行文化中，穆夏的风格被广泛应用于时尚、广告和产品设计，成为新艺术运动的标志性符号。他的女性形象已成为一个文化符号，代表着优雅、自然和女性美。尽管他的作品有时被视为过时，但穆夏对艺术与商业结合的探索，以及对民族文化的重视，使他成为现代设计史上的重要人物。
objective.en: From a historical and pop culture perspective, Mucha serves as an important bridge connecting late 19th-century decorative arts with 20th-century modern design. His works not only influenced contemporary visual arts but also had a profound impact on later decorative arts, graphic design, and illustration. In popular culture, Mucha's style has been widely applied in fashion, advertising, and product design, becoming an iconic symbol of the Art Nouveau movement. His female figures have become cultural symbols representing elegance, nature, and feminine beauty. Although his work is sometimes seen as outdated, Mucha's exploration of the fusion of art and commerce, along with his emphasis on national culture, establishes him as a significant figure in the history of modern design.

self.zh: 艺术是为人民服务的，而不是为少数精英服务的。
self.en: Art exists to decorate the lives of people, not to be locked away in galleries and museums.

others.zh: 穆夏是第一位将艺术带入日常生活的艺术家，他的作品使美成为每个人都能享受的东西。
others.en: Mucha was the first artist to bring art into everyday life, making beauty something that everyone could enjoy.
